# Druid — Feral

## Talent Prototype

This compact prototype uses two normal talent tiers plus one capstone. Talent identity and icon slugs are sourced from the Classic tree named **Feral Combat**. There are no per-node prerequisite chains; unlocks are controlled only by the structured tier thresholds in this JSON.

identity.role: Melee damage or defense through form
identity.resource: Energy in Cat Form; Rage in Bear Form
identity.auto_attack: Cat Claw in Cat Form; Bear Swipe in Bear Form

tier_1.name: Ferocity
tier_1.effect: Canonical Classic talent; prototype tuning is intentionally not substituted for the original talent text.

tier_2.name: Feline Swiftness
tier_2.effect: Canonical Classic talent; prototype tuning is intentionally not substituted for the original talent text.

capstones.name: Leader of the Pack
capstones.effect: Canonical Classic talent; prototype tuning is intentionally not substituted for the original talent text.

talent_model.tier_semantics: Talent tiers are prototype talent progression only and are unrelated to item/building T1–T5 progression.
